title: Playing a concert for children at the Henry Street Settlement
summary: Basie says the concert for kids was a new experience; he watched their faces and the kids came by for autographs.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: : I see. Could you talk a little about the concert you did last night at the Street Settlement (unintelligible) for the kids down there?
No -- yeah -- that was a new experience for me. I didn't know quite how to do this. I mean, because they were (unintelligible) all kids (inaudible) just what's going to happen. (Unintelligible)
: (Unintelligible) first time it had been done?
(Inaudible) I was -- I'm playing and I've still got my feelers out there. And the kids reacted pretty nicely (inaudible)
: How did you know they were interested?
Well, how they received different things; you know what I mean?

The expressions on their faces, how they reacted, and conversations we had with some of them who came by for autographs (unintelligible) some of the kids came back just to shake hands (unintelligible) for an autograph.
Yeah. I'm ready to go down there again because that's one (unintelligible). That's a great place to play. You know?
